description: This file defines a React component named VideoCaptureModal which manages video recording via webcam, including recording, preview, and upload functionalities. It interacts with external controllers such as FilesController and VideoRecorder, and uses React hooks and JSX for rendering.

methods.name: VideoCaptureModal
methods.description: React functional component that handles video recording experience, including initializing video recorder, starting/stopping recording, previewing video, and uploading the captured video.
